title: Protocol and Drop
author: Silas Zhou
blurb: Gideon Kavanagh, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
